import numpy as np
bins = np.arange(2.5, 6.75 + 0.25, 0.25)
df['bin_idx'] = pd.cut(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins=bins, right=False, labels=False)
df['체류시간_bin_mid'] = df['bin_idx'].apply(lambda i: bins[int(i)] + 0.125 if pd.notna(i) else np.nan)
group_counts = df.groupby(['촉매로트', '체류시간_bin_mid']).size().reset_index(name='n')
df = df.merge(group_counts, on=['촉매로트', '체류시간_bin_mid'])
def get_group(lot):
    return 'old' if lot in ['FC-2602', 'FC-2603', 'FC-2604', 'FC-2605'] else 'new'
df['촉매로트_그룹'] = df['촉매로트'].apply(get_group)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
for line in ax.get_lines():
    label = line.get_label()
    if label.startswith('_') or label == 'None': continue
    x_data = line.get_xdata()
    y_data = line.get_ydata()
    if len(x_data) == 0: continue
    idx_max = np.argmax(y_data)
    x_max = x_data[idx_max]
    y_max = y_data[idx_max]
    ax.plot(x_max, y_max, 'o', color=line.get_color(), markersize=8, zorder=5)
    ax.annotate(f'{x_max:.2f}', xy=(x_max, y_max), xytext=(0, 10), textcoords='offset points', ha='center', fontsize=9, color=line.get_color())
